law_name: Law No. 2012-038 of 17 July 2012 on literary and artistic property (copyright and related rights)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Art. 53 per Wikimedia Commons summary; text not seen; joint works from death of last surviving author) (unconfirmed)
notes: Law also covers collective management and traditional cultural heritage. Berne bound from 6 Feb 1973 (WIPO notification 39); WTO 31 May 1995 (Commons). Implementing regulations reportedly not adopted (WTO via Commons). Bureau Mauritanien du Droit d'Auteur not confirmed. WCT/WPPT not checked.
